motion.name: dialog-scrim-in
motion.purpose: Open scrim opacity 0 → 1; backdrop blur remains constant at 5px.

motion.name: dialog-scrim-out
motion.purpose: Closed scrim fades from its captured rendered opacity to 0; pointer events are disabled during exit.

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.purpose: Fresh entry: opacity 0 → 1, translate 0 12px → 0 0, scale 0.985 → 1. An interrupted exit resumes from its captured frame. Individual properties preserve the centered transform.

motion.name: dialog-out
motion.purpose: Fade captured opacity to 0, move 6px farther down from captured translation, multiply captured scale by 0.99. No fully-open restart; closing content does not intercept pointer events.

motion.name: menu-in
motion.purpose: Fresh DropdownMenu/Select entry: opacity 0 → 1, scale 0.98 → 1, vertical -4px (below) or +4px (above) to zero. Interrupted exits resume from their captured frame; retain the actual Radix transform origin.

motion.name: menu-out
motion.purpose: Fade captured opacity to 0, preserve captured translation, and multiply captured scale by 0.985; closing menu content does not intercept pointer events.

motion.name: tooltip-in
motion.purpose: Fresh delayed/instant-open tooltip opacity 0 → 1, or from a captured interrupted exit, independent of the existing 200ms provider delay.

motion.name: tooltip-out
motion.purpose: Closed tooltip fades from its captured rendered opacity to 0.

motion.name: review-in
motion.purpose: Shared wallet-operation-stage review entry: opacity 0.6 → 1 and translate 8px 0 → 0 0, preserving heading focus and exact review facts. Nested review animation is disabled to avoid duplication.

motion.name: edit-in
motion.purpose: Shared stage's returning form only (data-step=form, data-direction=back): opacity 0.6 → 1, translate -8px 0 → 0 0. Edit details within the same open modal retains its exact amount; fresh form entry adds no duplicate step animation.

motion.name: skeleton-breathe
motion.purpose: Decorative skeleton breathing, with opacity 0.45 at 50%; reduced motion disables it.

motion.name: scroll-behavior
motion.purpose: Section scrolling only. Reduced motion disables smooth scrolling, transitions and animations immediately, preserving state/focus. No money tween, privacy fade, page-load choreography, animated blur or persistent will-change. Static previews do not emulate portals or run entrance animations.

history.compact: Beside the total, above actions: 72px plot, 60px at max-width 640px, in a keyboard-operable button with 80px minimum height and 8px padding. history.emptyAndInvalid: Compact missing/empty: No history yet. Invalid: History unavailable. Private: History hidden. No invented line, figures, date range, return or zero series. Invalid, unsupported, wrong-account or ambiguous duplicate series must not expose another account's history.
history.dialog: Ready sparkline opens the shared portaled USD balance history Dialog: width min(640px, calc(100vw - 32px)), max-height calc(100dvh - 48px), internal scrolling, shared labelling/Escape/focus trap and trigger-focus return. Its history section has no top margin, inset or border.
history.dialogRoles: Chart -> var(--positive); marker boundary -> var(--solid); divider -> var(--line); ink -> var(--ink); muted -> var(--secondary). These are theme-aware existing roles, not new primitives.
history.heading: 16px semibold expanded subheading; the overview mounts no separate balance-history heading. Skeleton section titles remain 30px high.
history.expandedPlotHeight: 112px, explicitly scoped for both app and portaled history-dialog plots
history.expandedGrid: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0 36px, var(--balance-divider) 36px 37px); context only, not data
history.line: Straight segments; var(--balance-chart), 2.5px non-scaling stroke, round joins/caps; actual timestamp x spacing. Expanded vertical scale starts at zero; compact uses recorded min/max. Every polyline vertex remains, including dense series.
history.points: Single point implies no trend. Multi-point compact plots omit markers, not observations. Expanded plots above 24 points retain endpoint markers only; all vertices and exact table records remain. Markers use --balance-chart fill with a 1.5px non-scaling --balance-start boundary stroke.
history.details: Keyboard-accessible details table shows six exact USD records per page, with readable en-US UTC times and canonical time/dateTime values. Previous/Next disable at bounds; polite page status and controls wrap with an 8px gap and 16px top margin. Paging focuses the table caption and never slices the full chart. All exact records remain reachable; summary minimum target height 44px.
history.privacy: Immediately remove the compact trigger/plot and any open history dialog/table, monetary values and timestamps from the DOM and accessibility tree. Do not blur, fade or merely visually mask history.
history.loadingAndMotion: Overview skeleton reserves the compact 72px sparkline beside the amount using --balance-divider, not a separate chart/heading or notice. No fake trend, delay or new amount, point, line or missing-state animation.

currencyMarkers.assets: No emoji, font glyphs, downloads, external requests or new global color metadata.

walletPresentation.authority: Approved affected-section D-038 refresh/merge of the incumbent D-035/D-036/D-037 frosted identity, using current source and artifact/MODAL_CONTINUITY.md. Normative DESIGN.md frontmatter is byte-identical. Palette/colorMeta ramps and metadata, balance-card roles, font family, unrelated type/rounded/spacing primitives, elevation, existing motion values/easings, breakpoints and all 12 preview entries remain. Only affected prose/examples change; local review sizes are not global type tokens. Code-led composition, no new visual-world/quality-bar roll, dependency, asset or shipping raster.
walletPresentation.currencyRows: Desktop: minimum 76px, vertical padding 14px, final row minimum 70px and bottom padding 10px without divider. Max-width 760px: minimum 70px, vertical padding 12px, final minimum 64px and bottom padding 10px. Long values may grow; flags/codes/names remain.
walletPresentation.navigation: Overview / and full History /history with aria-current=page; the unused Wallets navigation item is hidden, not the currency-balance panel. Mobile has three labelled items: Overview, History, Actions; Actions opens all four money operations. Persistent route shell keeps account/privacy, non-amount selections and protected recovery mounted across navigation. It does not retain ordinary amount/review on a fresh explicit modal opening, including after soft navigation; reload clears ordinary drafts. Full-history filters/details are page-local, not promised after leaving the page.
walletPresentation.recent: At most five newest matching completed rows: income/outgoing/conversion Lucide icon, name, UTC time, exact signed amounts, completed check. Positive credits use + and positive ink; debits use minus and danger ink. Conversions show both legs. Rows open scoped details on /history; no Browse full history button or invented merchants/mini charts.
walletPresentation.completion: Desktop status includes check plus Completed text. Max-width 640px retains a visible check in a 20px circle; the label is screen-reader-only and Completed remains in the row's accessible name. Status does not rely on color or title alone.
walletPresentation.success: Validated definitive receipt only: centered 88px positive-ground circle with 48px green check; operation-specific complete heading, concise exact wrapping summary and Done only. Done/X/outside click/Escape clear safely confirmed result/reviews/quotes only with unblocked recovery cleanup; a definitive result arriving after dismissal resets on the next explicit open, and ordinary entry starts at literal 0. Pending/unknown outcomes, definitive-error original context and blocked recovery storage retain their original request/key/quote; closing never means canceled money movement. No retry key, quote ID, timestamp or technical balance/debug table in success. Privacy substitutes confirmation-only copy. Portfolio failures never relabel money outcomes.
walletPresentation.valuation: Independent selected main/destination USD totals from journal balances. Direct nonzero foreign-to-USD Frankfurter pairs; fresh-first with eligible exact-pair cache younger than 24h only. Per-wallet half-up rounding to USD cents, then exact sum; a tiny portfolio contribution may round to zero without weakening payment rules. Missing/invalid/expired required FX, overflow or stale revision means the whole current total is unavailable, never partial. USD-only/zero portfolios need no FX. No reciprocal/cross-rate synthesis or backfilled observations.
walletPresentation.provenance: Keyboard-focusable Currency rates tooltip trigger exposes fresh/cached reference provenance, exact pair, readable source date and original fetch time beside supporting copy, not another permanent card row. Reference, not live/streaming rates. Current total refreshes do not rewrite recorded observations.
walletPresentation.amountEntry: Shared MoneyAmountInput: type=text, inputMode=decimal, exact string grouping and caret preservation. Raw draft/API strings stay ungrouped; reject invalid edits/paste without floats, rounding or precision truncation. 100px high, padding 12px 0 12px 36px, transparent fill, zero radius/shadow, 2px control-border bottom edge; visible focus uses 3px navy and no ring, invalid uses danger plus copy. Symbol 36px; privacy blanks/read-only masks the current draft without destroying it, but each fresh ordinary modal opening resets amount to literal 0 and remounts caret/hint state. Other Input/Select geometry stays unchanged.
walletPresentation.freshOpening: Before paint, each explicit fresh opening of Deposit/Withdraw/Convert/Send money resets that operation's ordinary amount to literal 0, clears stale review/errors and invalidates quotes. Remount entry-local caret/hint state even on reopening a still-exiting dialog. Retain provider, recipient and permitted currency selections; normalize an unavailable exchange source or unsupported/identical Convert target. Edit details within the same open modal keeps the exact amount and is not a fresh-opening reset. Account/privacy and protected recovery remain mounted. Pending/unknown/definitive-error/blocked-storage original request/key/quote must never become an editable zero draft. Success resets only when definitive and cleanup is unblocked; financial services/accounting are unchanged.
walletPresentation.stepMotion: One wallet-operation-stage owns local entry; nested form/review animation is disabled. Reuse incumbent review/edit keyframes at 180ms/ease-settle: opacity 0.6 to 1, +8px review or -8px same-open Edit to zero; fresh form adds no duplicate entry. Pending/problem/recovery settle opacity 0.75 to 1 and vertical 6px to zero over 180ms; definitive-success stage settles opacity 0.75 to 1, vertical 10px to zero and scale 0.985 to 1 over 240ms. One bounded WAAPI dialog-height animation uses the existing 240ms/ease-settle tokens, parsing either 240ms or optimized .24s to milliseconds. Interruption cancels/retargets from the current rendered height; close/privacy/viewport resize/unmount/live reduced-motion change cancel resizing. Privacy/reduced motion suppress stage choreography; content remains visible by default, focus and truth are immediate. No old money DOM snapshot, value tween, per-frame JS, request delay, fake progress, animated blur or new dependency. Global opening/closing/menu motion is unchanged; intentionally paused 50% capture supplements are not settled-layout evidence.
walletPresentation.review: Shared MoneyReview for all four operations: wrapping heading/top Edit details, source identity, centered exact amount/currency, recipient/provider identity, then quote details when applicable and bottom danger Cancel/green success Confirm. Deposit places provider before destination wallet. Local heading 20px/600; amount clamp(28px, 6vw, 40px)/600/1.25 with 0.75em currency. Identity panels use existing line/control radius and 14px 16px padding; action columns 1:1.5 with 12px gap and 48px minimum height. Review never submits; quotes still expire and require renewed review. No modal Back to overview or draft footer copy.
walletPresentation.buttons: Shared success variant fills with theme positive and uses solid text (dark: pale mint/dark ink), shadow-sm and 90% hover opacity. loading disables, sets aria-busy and adds a decorative LoaderCircle to ordinary Buttons, spinning 900ms linear only while busy; reduced motion stops it, retaining readable loading text. asChild remains exactly one child without injected spinner siblings. Existing motion tokens/easings are unchanged; no fake request delay or completion claim.
walletPresentation.recipients: Radix Select offers saved destination addresses or Create new address, revealing a labelled shared Input for new entry. New defaults USD; save only with successful transfer, not selection/review. UI send/receive choices are USD/GBP/EUR; sending also needs an existing source wallet. Same-currency transfer remains allowed, unlike Convert. Preserve stored defaults: an unsupported saved default gets USD selected for receipt without rewriting metadata. Other balances stay visible and backend/conversion capabilities remain unrestricted by this picker.
walletPresentation.convertChoices: Both Convert source/receiving selectors expose only USD/GBP/EUR. Source requires an existing wallet; the identical receiving currency is disabled and a source change clears an identical target. The broader catalog hook no longer drives these UI choices. Extra balances remain visible and existing backend-eligible conversions are unchanged; server quote validation still governs confirmation.
walletPresentation.dates: Shared en-US UTC presentation across recent/full history and accessible row names, chart endpoints/table, quote expiry and rate provenance: readable month names, 12-hour times and UTC suffix for timestamps. Canonical API/storage values and existing time/dateTime attributes stay unchanged; rate date, fetch time and quote expiry remain distinct.
walletPresentation.recentEmpty: Centered on both axes in a minimum 260px region, 32px vertical padding and 16px gap: 64px icon circle with 32px decorative icon, No matching completed activity at 16px/600 and Your completed transactions will appear here. at normal 14px. Clear filter remains available when applicable; no invented activity or error styling.
walletPresentation.footer: Prototype · Local ledger only. No real funds move. One discreet secondary-ink 12px centered footer after content, with 24px top margin; no demo badge or large connection banner. Local unavailable/recovery/error guidance remains.
walletPresentation.providerLabel: Bank account is the presentation label for unchanged stored demo_bank; it is not a real-provider connection claim.

historyPresentation.sheet: Transaction history stays at page-title level with privacy and Back to overview; Completed transactions with History icon and a subdued wrapping account-ID tag sit above one frosted sheet. Outer route panel is transparent/unboxed, without duplicate Browse or nested-card heading. Sheet padding/radius are locally 20px/24px, then 16px/20px at max-width 640px; shared panel primitives stay unchanged. Existing app brand/header/navigation, themes and fixed-navigation clearance remain.
historyPresentation.filters: Labelled History type, History currency, From day (UTC), To day (UTC): four columns from 1024px, two at 641–1023px, one at max-width 640px. Edits remain staged until Apply; Apply and Clear reset to page 1. Currency matches either affected historical side; days remain inclusive UTC.
historyPresentation.lookup: Visible Search by transaction ID… is a separate exact account-scoped detail lookup through the existing read-only endpoint, not a fuzzy/as-you-type list filter. Explicit Enter or arrow submit; 44px square submit at zero top/trailing inset, with 36px leading and 48px trailing input padding. Preserve associated accessible label/hint, exact ID validation, missing/retry states and existing detail contracts; no financial submission.
historyPresentation.rows: One matching-count/page/Newest first summary above compact divided full-row actions: 32px circular direction icon, 14px/600 type and 12px readable UTC time left; exact signed 14px tabular amounts right, Completed check/label and 16px chevron. Minimum row height 56px, 8px vertical padding, 12px gaps; long facts may grow. Conversion uses navy on existing line ground; debit uses danger/minus, credit positive/plus. At max-width 640px use 28px icons, 13px type/amounts, 6px gaps, 12px vertical padding/chevron and a visible 20px completion check with screen-reader label. historyPresentation.recordedLegs: Conversion and outgoing transfer retain both stored signed debit/credit legs and currencies. Incoming inspection shows only the positive own receiving side in the row; details retain full source/target and original applicable rate provenance. Never net legs, reprice with current FX or fabricate historical facts. The reference image's eight examples are not runtime counts or seeds; actual account-scoped results determine the list.
historyPresentation.paging: Showing current-page row count of total transactions left; one Previous page/page-number input/Go to page/Next page group right, with bound disabling. 50 records per page, positive safe-integer page validation, and First page recovery for page > 1/out-of-range results remain. Max-width 640px wraps controls and moves the jump form to its own row. This is separate from the six-record USD balance-history table.
historyPresentation.disclosure: About these results carries applied query, inclusive UTC/either-side historical-currency semantics, the 50-record limit and the possibility that new activity shifts numbered pages. Summary target is at least 44px. Associated screen-reader field hints remain outside the closed disclosure.
historyPresentation.scopeAndStates: Account/query/revision/privacy scope and abort guards stay unchanged; stale/foreign facts never replace loading/error/empty/missing states. Detail/back preserves mounted filters/page and returns focus to the row or visible heading; account switching does not steal account-menu focus. Privacy immediately removes rows, amounts, counts, timestamps and lookup, retaining browsing context only in memory. No durable filters, current-FX request, money/recovery change or detail/backend-contract change.
historyPresentation.preview: No existing History/transaction preview was present among the 12 incumbent entries, so one self-contained Completed History sheet excerpt is added without replacing or expanding unrelated examples. Its two explicitly illustrative main-account rows are not normal-wallet facts, fixture seeds or the reference's eight rows. All controls are inert type=button/read-only fields, with inline SVG and ds- classes; no JavaScript, framework, lookup, paging or submission is connected. Surrounding app chrome remains outside the excerpt.

narrative.overview:
Icy-blue glass sits over a diffuse navy wash. Rounded panels and softly raised controls make the interface tactile without competing with balances, field labels, or review details. The approved reference supplies the material character, not a different banking product or a permanent page topology.

Workhorse system typography, purposeful Lucide icons, and restrained navy accents keep task completion ahead of decoration. Light and dark themes share the same material roles. Simulation notices, unavailable information, and disabled final actions remain legible parts of the composition rather than being disguised as successful financial activity.

The user-requested [balance-card refinement](artifact/BALANCE_CARD.md) adds one opaque navy-gradient anchor, identical in light and dark themes, and locally authored currency flags. The surrounding frosted world remains unchanged. Balance history shows only recorded USD-total observations; when recorded data is absent, show no invented figures or trend.

The [presentation refinement](artifact/PRESENTATION_REFINEMENT.md) (D-035/D-036) keeps this world and its core tokens. A compact recorded-total sparkline sits beside the amount, with actions below; tighter currency rows and five signed recent rows improve scanning. Full History is a real `/history` page in the persistent wallet shell, not an overview section. Confirmed success uses a concise green-check summary; uncertain outcomes retain recovery. Main and inspect-only destination totals are independently valued from journal balances with fresh/cached Frankfurter reference rates. One discreet prototype footer replaces the demo badge and large connection banner. Missing valuations never fabricate or backfill a trend.

The [workflow refinement](artifact/WORKFLOW_REFINEMENT.md) (D-037) composes the existing panels into amount-first entry/review, with a square bottom-border amount editor, green confirmation controls and honest request-loading feedback. Confirmed success has Done only; safe dismissal clears its result/review, never unresolved intent or blocked recovery cleanup. Readable UTC dates, centered recent empty states, six-record balance-table pages and saved/new recipient selection refine task clarity without changing the frosted identity or financial capabilities.

The [modal continuity follow-up](artifact/MODAL_CONTINUITY.md) (D-038) resets each ordinary amount to literal `0` on a fresh explicit opening of Deposit, Withdraw, Convert or Send money, clearing stale review/errors/quotes and remounting entry-local caret/hint state while retaining permitted provider, recipient and currency selections. Edit details within the same open modal keeps the exact amount. Protected original request/key/quote recovery is never reset into a zero draft. Both Convert selectors now use USD/GBP/EUR only; other balances and backend capabilities remain intact. Directional task stages, a bounded dialog-height resize and a verified-success settle reuse the existing motion world, with immediate privacy/reduced-motion behavior.

The [History reference refinement](artifact/HISTORY_REFERENCE.md) (D-039) applies compact completed-activity scanning to the existing frosted world. Its signed direction/status rows and visible exact-ID lookup reuse recorded facts and shared controls, not a new palette, financial capability or reference-image seed dataset. The History-only guidance below preserves D-038 modal continuity and recovery.

rules.name: The Theme Roles Rule
rules.body: Use semantic CSS properties in both themes; do not freeze light surfaces or white primary-action text into a theme-aware control. The approved logo icon and decorative currency flags are fixed-color asset exceptions; the logo wordmark follows ink, not on-navy action text. The explicitly user-requested opaque navy balance card is a card-scoped exception with local semantic roles identical in both themes, not a generic fixed-color rule.

rules.name: The Readable Figures Rule
rules.body: Keep tabular numerals, explicit currency labels, and wrapping long values. Format money through the existing minor-unit presentation helpers; do not visually truncate an amount or account ID to preserve a card silhouette.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use ambient shadows for panels and paired soft offsets for raised controls; bounded task overlays may settle through transform/opacity, not ornamental hover lift or animated blur.
